scenario: The ego vehicle passes another vehicle on a rural road and encroaches into the path of an oncoming vehicle traveling in the opposite direction.

ego.behavior: The car overtakes a slower vehicle ahead by moving into the opposing lane and continues forward.

adversarials.behavior: The car travels straight forward in the same direction as the ego vehicle, being overtaken by the ego.
The car travels straight forward in the opposite direction toward the ego vehicle.

spatial_relation: On a straight two-lane rural road with opposing traffic, the ego vehicle starts behind a same-direction vehicle and moves into the left opposing lane to pass, while an oncoming vehicle approaches from the opposite direction in that same left lane.
requirements_and_restrictions: The scenario occurs on a non-junction rural road with a posted speed limit of 55 mph or more, under clear daytime weather conditions; the scenario terminates upon collision or near-collision with the oncoming vehicle due to lane encroachment.
reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: Ego is the passing vehicle from first-person perspective; two adversarials are the vehicle being passed and the oncoming vehicle. 2. Enumeration: two adversarial cars, one same-direction and one opposite-direction. 3. Chronology: initially ego follows same-direction car; midpoint ego moves left into opposing lane to pass; ending ego confronts oncoming car head-on. 4. Evidence: ego's lateral position shifts left across centerline; oncoming car's relative size increases indicating approach; passed car falls behind.
